'''Primeval marrow''' was a rich meal made from the [[Bone/Legends|bone]] marrow of [[Primeval Prowler]]s, found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was one of the dishes served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Cooking" />
